subject: BIOL
title: Recovering Threatened Species and Ecosystems
summary: The media and scientific literature is full of information about the increasingly desperate plight of our native plants and animals.
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course, students must have successfully completed 72 units towards a degree including:
at least one of: BIOL2131 or BIOL2114 or BIOL2151 or ENVS2001, and
one of: BIOL2001 or BIOL2202 or ENVS1003.
Incompatible with BIOL6178
